#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstdint>

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long binpow(long long base, long long power) {
    long long result = 1LL;
    while (power > 0) {
        if (power & 1) {
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        }
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        power >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    std::istringstream iss(line);
    
    long long n, m, l, r;
    iss >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    long long area = n * m;

    if (area & 1) {
        std::cout << binpow(r - l + 1, area) << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }

    long long evenCount = r / 2 - (l - 1) / 2;
    long long oddCount = r - l + 1 - evenCount;

    long long answer = (binpow(evenCount + oddCount, area) + binpow(evenCount - oddCount, area)) % MOD;
    answer = (answer * binpow(2, MOD - 2)) % MOD;

    std::cout << answer << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
